packs.title: Encyclopedia
packs.description: English and Simple English Wikipedia in one offline collection. 8.39 million passages; 10.64 GB download, 24.35 GB installed. Dated snapshots, not live information.

packs.title: Encyclopedia: search by meaning
packs.description: Finds passages anywhere in the Encyclopedia (8,386,572 of them) by what a question means, even when it uses other words. Needs the Encyclopedia · November 2026.

packs.title: Encyclopedia: search by meaning
packs.description: The opening of every Simple English Wikipedia article (211,112 subjects), searched by meaning, so a question finds its subject even in other words · November 2026.

packs.title: Travel guides
packs.description: 31,672 Wikivoyage guides by section: getting in and around, money, safety, health, etiquette, travel topics and phrasebooks · September 2026 snapshot.

packs.title: Travel guides: search by meaning
packs.description: Finds sections of the travel guides (363,815 of them) by what a question means, even when it uses other words. Needs Travel guides · November 2026.

packs.title: Travel places
packs.description: Restaurants, hotels, sights, and shops · September 2026. Listings may be outdated.

packs.title: Vegan places
packs.description: 52,064 restaurants, cafés, and shops OpenStreetMap tags as fully vegan or with vegan options, worldwide, with near-me lookups · October 2026. Tags can be outdated.

packs.title: Essentials
packs.description: 2,981,023 pharmacies, hospitals, ATMs, toilets, drinking water, stations, supermarkets and hostels OpenStreetMap maps worldwide, with near-me lookups · October 2026. Details can be outdated.

packs.title: Cryptography & Ethereum
packs.description: 22,805 passages from the Ethereum Improvement Proposals and ERCs, the consensus specifications, NIST post-quantum standards and 123 Wikipedia articles, with local vector search · October 2026.
